dedupe_keys.name: transitionzero asia 24 7 carbon free power models

description: This TransitionZero repository contains PyPSA electricity-system models and a reproducible workflow for testing 24-hour carbon-free energy procurement in India, Japan, Taiwan, Malaysia and Singapore. Users set region, demand, generation and procurement assumptions, then build and solve brownfield power systems and carbon-free scenarios. Outputs include capacity, cost and dispatch comparisons for the configured countries or nodes. Geographic coverage is the five study countries, with examples such as Hokkaido. MIT source, environment files, country configurations and explicit build and solve commands are public. The README labels the study under construction and offers both HiGHS and Gurobi solver settings, so conclusions and data releases may still change. A limitation is that the scenarios are research counterfactuals, not observed procurement outcomes. The models can test data-centre or industrial clean-power strategies. The related catalogue PyPSA is the underlying framework, not these Asian cases. No network files, solver or data were downloaded.
inputs: Country power-system configurations and CFE procurement scenarios
name: TransitionZero Asia 24-7 carbon-free power models
